  <circle cx="195" cy="790" r="17" fill="#E8F6FD"/>

  <text x="277" y="824" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#676767">Wallet</text>
  <!-- profile -->
  <circle cx="338" cy="787" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#676767" stroke-width="2"/>
  <ellipse cx="338" cy="799" rx="11" ry="6" fill="none" stroke="#676767" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="338" y="824" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#676767">Profile</text>
</svg>
